decided: When a project signs off at every change's archive and the change has a pull request, the archive's one-line note of files it committed that git never tracked names the record of the user's sign-off. The archive's kept copy of the brief stays left out of that note, as it is today.
alternatives: leave the sign-off record out of the note, as the kept copy of the brief is
why: The sign-off is the user's own answer rather than something the archive wrote for itself, and naming it shows that it was committed with the work; with sign-off off no such record exists, so the note is unchanged.
